name: onecall-openapi-contract
description: Static OpenAPI 3.1 contract and validation harness for the ONECALL five trust surfaces.

scripts.bundle: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('../../tmp/openapi-client',{recursive:true})" && redocly bundle onecall-v1.openapi.yaml --config redocly.yaml -o ../../tmp/openapi-client/onecall-v1.bundle.json --ext json
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run bundle && npm run generate && npm run typecheck && npm run doc-map && npm run lint:media-gateway
scripts.check:s1: npm run check && node check-doc-map.mjs ../../tmp/openapi-client/onecall-v1.bundle.json ../../docs/15-production-openapi-surface-spec.md --stage s1 --source onecall-v1.openapi.yaml
scripts.check:s2: npm run check && node check-doc-map.mjs ../../tmp/openapi-client/onecall-v1.bundle.json ../../docs/15-production-openapi-surface-spec.md --stage s2 --source onecall-v1.openapi.yaml
scripts.check:s3: npm run check && node check-doc-map.mjs ../../tmp/openapi-client/onecall-v1.bundle.json ../../docs/15-production-openapi-surface-spec.md --stage s3 --source onecall-v1.openapi.yaml
